cases.name: Fontella Galloway
cases.about: She was a retired schoolteacher and member of the LDS church.
cases.narrative: On 6/16/1969, a 14-year-old youth named Lynn Castro who came to mow her lawn found her deceased. Her hands were tied behind her back and then to an iron bed, causing her to slouch forward. This resulted in positional asphyxiation due to her to be unable to breath.
